title: SLO
description: Every blackbox probe (HTTP, TCP, TLS, ICMP, DNS), certificate expiry, 30-day availability and error budget. Includes the former "App SLO" dashboard (Apps rows).

list.name: slo
list.label: SLO target %
list.description: Availability objective. Alerts (SloFastBurn/SloSlowBurn) use 99.9; keep in sync with prometheus/rules/alerts.yml.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: Services of job apps with traffic.

panels.title: Days until certificate expires
panels.description: HTTPS and TLS probes only. Warning under 14 days, critical under 3.

panels.title: Availability and error budget, last 30 days
panels.description: Availability = share of successful probes. Budget left = how much of the allowed failure (100 - SLO) is still unused; below 0 = SLO missed. Needs the recording rule job_instance:probe_success:avg5m, so history starts when it was added.

panels.title: Burn rate (1h)
panels.description: 1 = budget lasts exactly 30 days. 6 and 14.4 are the SloSlowBurn/SloFastBurn thresholds.

options.content:
**Availability SLO 99.5%** → budget 0.5% of requests may fail (5xx). **Latency SLO 99.0%** → budget 1% may take over 1s.  
**Budget left** 100% = untouched, 0% = used up (stop risky deploys, fix reliability first). **Burn 1h** above 14.4x pages, above 6x over 6h warns. Click a service name to filter, or jump to its endpoints.

panels.title: SLO per service
panels.description: Empty: No app traffic: job apps has no http_requests_total yet.

targets.expr: (1 - (sum by (service) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"5.."}[30d])) / sum by (service) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[30d])))) * 100

(1 - (sum by (service) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"5.."}[30d])) / sum by (service) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[30d]))) / 0.005) * 100

(1 - (1 - sum by (service) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", service=~"$service", le="1"}[30d])) / sum by (service) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[30d])))) * 100

(1 - (1 - sum by (service) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", service=~"$service", le="1"}[30d])) / sum by (service) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[30d]))) / 0.01) * 100

panels.title: Availability 30d
panels.description: Worst selected service. Raw counters over 30 days (VictoriaMetrics).

targets.expr: min((1 - (sum by (service) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"5.."}[30d])) / sum by (service) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[30d])))) * 100)

panels.title: Error budget left
panels.description: Worst selected service. Negative = objective already missed this month.

targets.expr: min((1 - (sum by (service) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"5.."}[30d])) / sum by (service) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[30d]))) / 0.005) * 100)

panels.title: Error burn rate
panels.description: 1x = budget lasts exactly 30 days. Fast-burn alert: 1h and 5m above 14.4x. Slow-burn: 6h and 30m above 6x.

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: Dashed line = budget (0.5%). Spending above it eats the budget.

targets.expr: min((1 - (1 - sum by (service) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", service=~"$service", le="1"}[30d])) / sum by (service) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[30d])))) * 100)

min((1 - (1 - sum by (service) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", service=~"$service", le="1"}[30d])) / sum by (service) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[30d]))) / 0.01) * 100)

panels.title: Share slower than 1s
panels.description: Needs http_request_duration_seconds with a le="1" bucket (Prometheus client defaults have it).

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Below 0.05 req/s the burn-rate alerts stay quiet: a single failure on an idle service is not an outage.

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)
